{
 "path": "programs/task-06433464.py",
 "content": "def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    cells = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == 3]
    if not cells:
        raise ValueError("missing 3 marker")
    r0 = min(r for r, _ in cells)
    r1 = max(r for r, _ in cells)
    c0 = min(c for _, c in cells)
    c1 = max(c for _, c in cells)
    if len(cells) != (r1-r0+1)*(c1-c0+1):
        raise ValueError("marker is not a filled rectangle")
    return [[grid[h-1-(r0+i)][w-1-(c0+j)] for j in range(c1-c0+1)] for i in range(r1-r0+1)]
"
}
